page_title: PAL 1-0 GRA | Las Palmas v Granada CF 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+2' 1 - 0 Kirian (Las Palmas) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas) replaces Enzo Loiodice.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Alvaro Fernandez (Granada CF). Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
88' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Las Palmas can continue in their attacking effort.
86' A player from Granada CF commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
82' Today's referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea rightly decides to book Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) for his harsh tackle.
81' Today's match ends for Lucas Boye who will be replaced by Famara Diedhiou (Granada CF).
80' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
78' A cross from Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Las Palmas.
73' The substitution has been made. Victor Diaz (Granada CF) has replaced Raul Torrent.
73' Paco Lopez decides to make a substitution. Carlos Neva will be replaced by Alvaro Fernandez (Granada CF).
73' Substitution. Oscar Melendo did his best and is replaced by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF).
73' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Granada CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) was quite harsh and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Granada CF.
69' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
67' Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick.
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Munir El Haddadi will be replaced by Sory Kaba (Las Palmas).
66' Here is a change. Jonathan Viera is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).
65' Granada CF force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
64' The game has come to an end for Gerard Gumbau. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF).
63' Granada CF get a corner.
60' Substitution. Maximo Perrone will be replaced by Saul Coco (Las Palmas).
60' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Alvaro Valles easily deals with the threat.
58' The main referee, Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Omenuke Mfulu (Las Palmas) is given a yellow card for dissent.
58' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
57' A snap shot by Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Alvaro Valles flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
55' NO PENALTY! Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Granada CF players are incensed.
53' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Granada CF using VAR. Let's see what happens.
52' Handball! A player from Las Palmas handled the ball. It's a penalty to Granada CF! Let's see who's going to take it.
52' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Granada CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' A cross by Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
49' Las Palmas are ruled offside.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas).
46' Half-time substitution. Pejino will not participate anymore and Marvin (Las Palmas) is coming on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Las Palmas take a short corner kick.
45+4' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+4' The game is interrupted now, Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' Granada CF are ruled offside.
43' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) is penalised.
41' The foul by Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea.
40' Granada CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
39' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
39' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows the yellow card to Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) for a heavy challenge.
39' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
36' Kirian (Las Palmas) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
34' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
34' Las Palmas will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
32' A corner kick by Granada CF is thwarted by the well prepared Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas).
31' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
28' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
27' Las Palmas are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
24' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) trips an opposition player and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a foul.
22' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) has a goal ruled out for offside!
20' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
19' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Granada CF was in an offside position.
17' A player from Las Palmas commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Las Palmas.
14' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
12' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
10' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
7' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) for his blatant foul.
6' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' A cross from a corner kick by Las Palmas is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
5' Las Palmas have a goal ruled out for offside!
3' Kirian (Las Palmas) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
1' One of the players from Las Palmas times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Las Palmas will kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea is the one to supervise the game today.
